colour.dataset: CompCars surveillance, official classification test split
colour.exclusions: 10 official test keys and 30 official train keys are absent from the committed manifest

make.exclusions: 17 official test keys and 13 official train keys are absent from the committed manifest; of the 16,003 manifest train rows, 1 was excluded as a duplicate of test content or as a conflicting label and 1 duplicate representative of an identical-byte group was removed, leaving 16,001 fit and validation rows

body_type.dataset: CompCars web classification test split, minus unavailable labels
body_type.exclusions: the same 17 absent test keys and 13 absent official train keys; 352 test rows and 369 train rows whose official body type is 0 (unavailable); 3 duplicate or conflicting exclusions; leaving 15,631 fit and validation rows

shared: Route-1 populations are declared subsets of the official test splits, not the complete official test sets. The three attributes use different datasets and class counts, so no combined score is defined.
